differences.ruf041-forward-module-value-overrides-lo: Static-typing scope policy difference: an enclosing local typing.Literal import defines the annotation names lexically. Default runtime get_type_hints instead sees conflicting module globals; explicit enclosing locals recover typing.Literal. Both actual outcomes are retained. Intended RUF041 applies to lexical typing.Literal, not arbitrary runtime subscriptions, and does not promise universal runtime-introspection equivalence.

primary_basis.basis: Type parameters introduce a lexical scope enclosing annotations, independently of postponed evaluation.
Literal accepts other literal types, whose flattening is equivalent under typing semantics. Arbitrary parameter objects are not imported typing.Literal.
Postponing evaluation does not change static typing analysis.
Runtime introspection requires appropriate namespaces and may lose enclosing function locals.
Pinned rule concerns equivalent nested Literal flattening, not arbitrary subscriptions.

versions: Canonical py310 retains every existing unsupported-PEP695 diagnostic. Actual CPython3.13 controls establish supported3.12+ parameter identity and annotation resolution; no generic-header source is claimed to execute under3.10. Actual3.10 and3.13 scope controls both retain default globals vs explicit enclosing locals. Controls with added return f,locals() and custom=list binding are explicitly changed model programs, not unchanged recovered fixtures.
limits: Seven exact complete source/output multisets only. No missing import or decorator execution is asserted for recovered originals; no unrelated diagnostics, skipped accounting or uncertainty is waived. Original41source bodies and both full upstream fixtures preserved.
